name: _primaryKey
description: Unique record identifier (embedded VIN + dealer code + snapshot date).

name: firstSeen
description: Date when the listing was first observed (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: year
description: Vehicle model year.

name: make
description: Vehicle manufacturer (e.g., Ford, Toyota, BMW).

name: model
description: Vehicle model name.

name: trim
description: Trim level (e.g., 330i, RS).

name: bodyStyle
description: Body style (SUV, Sedan, Pickup, Wagon, Coupe, Hatchback, Minivan, Convertible, Van, Chassis).

name: vehicle_class
description: Chinese body-style class derived from bodyStyle (e.g., 小轿车, SUV, 皮卡).

name: engine
description: Engine configuration (e.g., 4 Cyl, 6 Cyl).

name: displacement
description: Engine displacement (e.g., 2.0 L).

name: drivetrain
description: Drivetrain (FWD, AWD, 4WD, RWD).

name: transmission
description: Transmission type (Automatic, Manual, Unspecified).

name: fuelType
description: Fuel type (Gasoline, Hybrid, Diesel, Electric, Flexible-Fuel, Alternative).

name: energy_class
description: Chinese energy-source class derived from fuelType (e.g., 燃油, 混动, 纯电).

name: category
description: Combined Chinese category label: energy_class + vehicle_class.

name: mileage
description: Odometer reading in miles.

name: noAccidents
description: True when the listing reports no accidents. Missing values mean the information was not reported (non-null values are all True).

name: serviceRecords
description: True when service records are available. Missing values mean the information was not reported (non-null values are all True).

name: serviceRecordCount
description: Number of service history records.

name: personalUse
description: True when the vehicle is reported for personal use. Missing values mean the information was not reported (non-null values are all True).

name: oneOwner
description: True when the vehicle has a single owner. Missing values mean the information was not reported (non-null values are all True).

name: onePrice
description: CARFAX One Price estimate / asking price in USD.

name: badge
description: CARFAX value badge (GOOD, GREAT, FAIR).

name: snapshotDamageSeverity
description: Reported damage severity from the listing snapshot.

name: reliabilityBadge
description: Reliability badge (e.g., GOOD, AVERAGE).

name: reliabilityAvgCost
description: Average repair cost in USD.
